_note: The fixture account and the sign-in case table. Not secrets — the password is the static one every demo test account uses. In `cases` the key is the test ID and the row is what that test is called in the Allure report, when it runs and how much it matters. `identifierKey` names a field on the account below, so covering a new identifier is a new row and no TypeScript change. Renaming a title orphans that test's Allure trend line, so treat these as series names rather than free text.
